name: Batford Springs Play Park
description: A play park in Batford Springs Local Nature Reserve on Lower Luton Road, with equipment for children up to 13, picnic benches, a woodland boardwalk and a riverside path.

sources.label: Harpenden Town Council: Batford Springs Nature Reserve

notConfirmed: Exact position (taken from OpenStreetMap), play equipment, opening hours, toilets and parking. The pin is the playground on OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors) at the reserve.
